summary: Security lens of the story autoreview pass. PID-reuse protection is preserved end to end: create_time() identity is captured at spawn, compared adjacent to every signal (batch snapshots rejected), and reconcile now FAILS CLOSED on a legacy or unparseable recorded identity instead of reaping an unverified process. The token sweep proves ownership (username match) before any command-line fallback, and unreadable environs are skipped, never trusted. No user-global config writes; elevation stays deferred per 0040/D-0021. doctor --fix never uses --break-system-packages and surfaces PEP-668 refusals honestly.

non_blocking_findings.summary: legacy pid_started rows fail closed in reconcile (fixed this round) — no signal is ever sent to an identity Forge cannot verify

residual_risks: same-user malicious processes could spoof the FORGE_PROCESS_TOKEN cmdline marker to get adopted into a reap set — bounded to termination of the attacker's own process; delegation/proof commands are trusted inputs per AGENTS.md
orchestrated elevation remains deferred (0040/D-0021); workspace-write is the recorded sandbox
recommendation: no security blockers; elevation class stays deferred by decision
